title: Not as advertised.
text: Not as advertised.. I doubt that this is a 1000 thread count pillow case. The fabric is fairly stiff, and not soft, like one would expect. It's an OK pillow case. Just not what I expected.

product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR 1000 Thread Count Egyptian Cotton Set, Covers for All Pillows and Sleepers Pillowcases, Standard, White, 2
features: SUBTLE SOFTNESS. Our 100% Egyptian Cotton is specially combed to remove all but the finest and longest fibers, making these 1000 thread count pillowcases the ultimate in luxury

COZY OVERSIZED FIT. This 2 Piece Standard Pillowcase Set Includes: Two Oversized Pillowcases measuring 21" x 32" each. 1000 Thread Count Egyptian Cotton is soft, strong, and if cared for properly, will be long lasting

CLASSIC STYLE. The variety of vibrant colors are available in various sizes, featuring a lustrous sheen from the sateen weave. Complete your bedroom décor with the coordinating Duvet Covers and Sheet Sets for a plush, put together look
EASE OF CARE. These beautiful pillowcases are colorfast and machine washable. For drying, tumble dry low and remove them promptly from dryer. Always follow care label instructions for best results
description: Rest your head on a cloud with the Superior Egyptian Cotton 1000 Thread Count Solid Pillowcase Set.. This gorgeous duo is expertly crafted with silky-smooth, 100% Egyptian Cotton that provides comfort for the ultimate night's sleep. The longer fibers and tight weave construction make Egyptian Cotton softer, more lightweight, and more durable than any other cotton. The indulgently soft, 1000-thread count provides luxury and lasting durability that will transform your bedroom into a relaxing retreat. Open on one end for easy access, each pillowcase is finished with a 4 inch, luxurious tuxedo stitch pintuck hem for utmost style. Add a lively accent to your space with a variety of festive, solid colors that boast a subtle shimmer from their sateen weave and make the decorating options endless.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine washable. Please follow the instructions on the care label in order to minimize wrinkling and/or shrinkage. Remove bedding from the dryer promptly, press with a warm iron if necessary.
